summary: Completed testing of EduNet Schedule Module (Horario de Clases). Backend APIs all working correctly (11/13 tests passed, 2 skipped). Frontend schedule page loads correctly with all components. Fixed 2 frontend bugs: 1) Wrong API endpoint for subjects, 2) Subject data format mismatch.
passed_tests: GET /api/schedule-settings - returns persistent settings by school_id
GET /api/schedules with grado_id and seccion_id filters - returns filtered schedules
PUT /api/schedules/{id} - updates schedule with conflict validation
Section conflict detection - rejects duplicate section at same time
Frontend: /horarios page loads with correct layout and sidebar
Frontend: Schedule tabs (Clases, Profesores, Exámenes) work correctly
Frontend: Grade and Section selectors filter correctly
Frontend: Settings modal opens with all configuration options
Frontend: Calendar grid displays with days and time slots
Frontend: Add schedule modal has all required fields
Frontend: Subjects dropdown loads and displays with teacher names
Frontend: Subject selection auto-fills teacher and color

bugs_fixed.issue: Wrong API endpoint for subjects - was /api/subjects, should be /api/academic/subjects
Subject API response format mismatch - API returns array directly, code expected {subjects: [...]}
Teacher ID extraction from subject - was using subject.teacher_id but API returns primary_teacher.id
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated to use subject.primary_teacher?.id || subject.assigned_teachers?.[0]?.id || subject.teacher_id

bugs_fixed.issue: Teacher display in dropdown - was looking for teacher_id but API provides primary_teacher object
bugs_fixed.fix: Updated to use subject.primary_teacher || subject.assigned_teachers?.[0] for teacher display

critical_code_review_comments: ESLint warnings for missing 'headers' dependency in useEffect hooks - minor issue, doesn't affect functionality

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 executed tests passed, 2 skipped due to test data requirements)

Subjects load from /api/academic/subjects?grade_id=X and include primary_teacher object with teacher details.

frontend_components.calendar_grid: Weekly view with 6 days (Lun-Sáb) and configurable time slots

frontend_components.entry_modal: Add/Edit schedule with subject search, teacher auto-fill, day selection, time selection, room, color
